title: Sir Thomas Deane
html_source:
Sir Thomas Newenham Deane
(1828–99). Irish architect. He was the son of Sir Thomas Deane (1792–1871), who founded one of the most successful architectural practices in Ireland. Deane&Woodward designed the beautiful Trinity College Museum, Dublin (1852–7), which established their reputation.
